1.sahih_international: When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake
1.pickthall: When Earth is shaken with her (final) earthquake
1.yusuf_ali: When the earth is shaken to her (utmost) convulsion,
1.shakir: When the earth is shaken with her (violent) shaking,
1.muhammad_sarwar: When the earth is shaken by a terrible quake
1.mohsin_khan: When the earth is shaken with its (final) earthquake.
1.arberry: When earth is shaken with a mighty shaking

2.sahih_international: And the earth discharges its burdens
2.pickthall: And Earth yieldeth up her burdens,
2.yusuf_ali: And the earth throws up her burdens (from within),
2.shakir: And the earth brings forth her burdens,
2.muhammad_sarwar: and it throws out its burden,
2.mohsin_khan: And when the earth throws out its burdens,
2.arberry: and earth brings forth her burdens,

3.sahih_international: And man says, "What is [wrong] with it?" -
3.pickthall: And man saith: What aileth her?
3.yusuf_ali: And man cries (distressed): 'What is the matter with her?'-
3.shakir: And man says: What has befallen her?
3.muhammad_sarwar: the human being will say (in horror), "What is happening to it?"
3.mohsin_khan: And man will say: "What is the matter with it?"

4.sahih_international: That Day, it will report its news
4.pickthall: That day she will relate her chronicles,
4.yusuf_ali: On that Day will she declare her tidings:
4.shakir: On that day she shall tell her news,
4.muhammad_sarwar: On that day the earth will declare all (the activities of the human being) which have taken place on it,
4.mohsin_khan: That Day it will declare its information (about all what happened over it of good or evil).
4.arberry: upon that day she shall tell her tidings

5.sahih_international: Because your Lord has commanded it.
5.yusuf_ali: For that thy Lord will have given her inspiration.
5.shakir: Because your Lord had inspired her.
5.muhammad_sarwar: having been inspired by your Lord.
5.mohsin_khan: Because your Lord has inspired it.
5.arberry: for that her Lord has inspired her.

6.sahih_international: That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds.
6.pickthall: That day mankind will issue forth in scattered groups to be shown their deeds.
6.yusuf_ali: On that Day will men proceed in companies sorted out, to be shown the deeds that they (had done).
6.shakir: On that day men shall come forth in sundry bodies that they may be shown their works.
6.muhammad_sarwar: On that day, people will come out of their graves in different groups to see (the results of) their own deeds.
6.mohsin_khan: That Day mankind will proceed in scattered groups that they may be shown their deeds.
6.arberry: Upon that day men shall issue in scatterings to see their works,

7.sahih_international: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it,
7.pickthall: And whoso doeth good an atom's weight will see it then,
7.yusuf_ali: Then shall anyone who has done an atom's weight of good, see it!
7.shakir: So. he who has done an atom's weight of good shall see it
7.muhammad_sarwar: Whoever has done an atom's weight of good,
7.mohsin_khan: So whosoever does good equal to the weight of an atom (or a small ant), shall see it.
7.arberry: and whoso has done an atom's weight of good shall see it,

8.sahih_international: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.
8.pickthall: And whoso doeth ill an atom's weight will see it then.
8.yusuf_ali: And anyone who has done an atom's weight of evil, shall see it.
8.shakir: And he who has done an atom's weight of evil shall see it.
8.muhammad_sarwar: will see it and whoever has done an atom's weight of evil, will also see it.
8.mohsin_khan: And whosoever does evil equal to the weight of an atom (or a small ant), shall see it.
8.arberry: and whoso has done an atom's weight of evil shall see it.
